"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { initLenis, getLenis, destroyLenis } from "@/lib/lenis";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { SVGLoader } from "three/examples/jsm/loaders/SVGLoader";

export default function SvgLineAnimation() {
  const mountRef = useRef();

  useEffect(() => {
    initLenis();

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      60,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      10000
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true });
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    mountRef.current.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const loader = new SVGLoader();

    let geometry;
    let line;
    let points = [];
    let currentDraw = 0;
    let totalHeight = 1;
    let currentY = 0;

    loader.load("/line.svg", (data) => {
      data.paths.forEach((path) => {
        path.toShapes(true).forEach((shape) => {
          shape.getSpacedPoints(800).forEach((p) => {
            points.push(new THREE.Vector3(p.x, -p.y, 0));
          });
        });
      });

      geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);

      // Center & Scale
      geometry.computeBoundingBox();
      const box = geometry.boundingBox;
      const size = new THREE.Vector3();
      box.getSize(size);
      const center = new THREE.Vector3();
      box.getCenter(center);
      geometry.translate(-center.x, -center.y, 0);

      const desiredWidth = window.innerWidth * 1.2;
      const desiredHeight = window.innerHeight * 4;

      const scaleX = desiredWidth / size.x;
      const scaleY = desiredHeight / size.y;

      const scale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY); // maintain ratio

      geometry.scale(scale, scale, scale);


      const material = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: "#D3ED05" });
      line = new THREE.Line(geometry, material);
      scene.add(line);

      camera.position.z = 1000;
      camera.position.y = totalHeight / 2;

      // Initially hide all
      geometry.setDrawRange(0, 2);
    });

    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      if (!geometry) return;

      const lenis = getLenis();
      const scrollTop = lenis?.animatedScroll ?? window.scrollY;
      const maxScroll = document.body.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
      const scrollPercent = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(scrollTop / maxScroll, 0, 1);

      // Scroll-controlled draw
      const targetDraw = Math.floor(points.length * scrollPercent);
      currentDraw += (targetDraw - currentDraw) * 0.1;
      geometry.setDrawRange(0, Math.max(2, Math.floor(currentDraw)));

      // Camera follow
      const targetY = totalHeight / 2 - scrollPercent * totalHeight;
      currentY += (targetY - currentY) * 0.1;
      camera.position.y = currentY;

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();

    const handleResize = () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
      mountRef.current.removeChild(renderer.domElement);
      destroyLenis();
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div style={{ height: "500vh" }}>
      <div ref={mountRef} style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0 }} />
    </div>
  );
}
